title: {Syn} HyperLogLog Counts Huge Sets Approximately
content:
HyperLogLog estimates the number of distinct elements in a stream using very small memory. It watches patterns in hashed values rather than storing the elements.

The algorithm is popular in analytics systems because exact cardinality can be expensive, while a stable estimate is often enough.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
